title: Controlador De Serviços
description:
Controller Jurídico Local: Curitiba/PR
Vaga presencial

Objetivos do cargo

Garantir a padronização, conformidade e eficiência na execução dos processos e prazos judiciais e administrativos do escritório, prestando suporte técnico à equipe jurídica e manutenção da organização sistêmica e operacional.

Responsabilidades

  • Importar e tratar as publicações diárias no sistema jurídico, identificando prazos e providências cabíveis
  • Realizar o protocolo de peças e documentos judiciais, zelando pelo cumprimento dos prazos legais e operacionais
  • Realizar o arquivamento e controle de fichas processuais
  • Elaborar e manter atualizada a pauta de audiências e sustentações, organizando o calendário de compromissos processuais
  • Revisar tecnicamente as petições e demais atos processuais antes de seu protocolo, assegurando qualidade técnica e alinhamento estratégico
  • Padronizar modelos de peças, petições e recursos utilizados pela controladoria, promovendo uniformidade e eficiência documental
  • Analisar decisões judiciais relevantes e propor medidas jurídicas cabíveis, em conjunto com a equipe técnica
  • Contribuir para a formação da equipe da controladoria por meio de treinamentos sobre prazos, teses e boas práticas
  • Identificar e sinalizar erros recorrentes nos fluxos jurídicos, propondo ajustes e melhorias nos processos
  • Apoiar o núcleo técnico com pareceres ou apontamentos em casos de maior complexidade
  • Apoiar o núcleo técnico com pareceres ou apontamentos em casos de maior complexidade
  • Garantir a consistência e qualidade na documentação jurídica
  • Criação de modelos de petições, checklists e fluxogramas
  • Elaborar relatórios diários/semanais com base nos dados de desempenho e andamento dos processos

Requisitos e conhecimentos específicos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Direito
  • Experiência comprovada com controladoria jurídica
  • Domínio nos sistemas jurídicos dos tribunais brasileiros como um todo, entre eles notadamente Justiça Estadual e Justiça Federal
  • Experiência com automações jurídicas
  • Conhecimento avançado das normas do CPC e legislação aplicável
  • Saber identificar tipos de ações, prazos, fases do processo (judicial e administrativo)
  • Conhecimento Intermediário/avançado do software do escritório (CPJ-3C – Versão H)

Competências comportamentais

  • Liderança e visão sistêmica
  • Organização e foco em processos
  • Comunicação clara e didática
  • Proatividade
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Colaboração e empatia com diferentes equipes

Para participar do processo seletivo o(a) candidato(a) deve enviar currículo com a média de remuneração desejada, para o seguinte endereço eletrônico: ****** no assunto "vaga para Controller Jurídico"

description:
Missão do Cargo:

Você será responsável pela supervisão, desenvolvimento e performance da nossa equipe de campo. Sua missão é garantir a excelência na execução dos pontos de venda (PDV), o atingimento das metas de sell out e o crescimento sustentável das nossas marcas icônicas nos clientes sob sua responsabilidade.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento: Liderar, acompanhar e desenvolver a equipe de consultores(as) de vendas através de visitas constantes a campo, orientações contínuas, feedbacks estruturados e avaliações de desempenho.
  • Gestão de Resultados: Elaborar, implementar e acompanhar planos de ação focados no atingimento das metas de sell out, produtividade e indicadores de performance (KPIs).
  • Excelência em Execução: Garantir o padrão de luxo nos PDVs, assegurando a correta exposição, estoque adequado, implementação de materiais de merchandising e total aderência às diretrizes das marcas.
  • Negociação Comercial: Realizar negociações de sell out com clientes e gestores de loja, buscando oportunidades de incremento de vendas, ações promocionais e fortalecimento do relacionamento comercial.
  • Análise e Reporting: Monitorar resultados, analisar indicadores e reportar o desempenho à gestão, propondo melhorias e ações corretivas sempre que necessário.
  • Interface Estratégica: Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas internas (Formação, Trade Marketing, Comercial e RH), garantindo alinhamento estratégico e execução eficiente.
  • Gestão de Gente: Conduzir processos de recrutamento, seleção, admissão e integração de novos colaboradores da equipe de campo, garantindo a manutenção do engajamento e do clima organizacional.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência: Vivência prévia com gestão de pessoas e liderança de times.
  • Vivência de Mercado: Experiência com PDVs multimarcas e negociação direta com lojas do segmento de beleza/luxo.
  • Habilidades: Forte capacidade de liderança, comunicação assertiva e análise crítica de resultados.
  • Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para visitas frequentes a campo e viagens esporádicas.

description:

  • Cumprir, difundir e sugerir melhorias nas normas, procedimentos e instruções de trabalho relacionadas à Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Saúde Ocupacional, zelando pela segurança e bem-estar individual e coletivo.

title: Médico do Trabalho - Macaé (RJ)
description:
Junte-se ao DOF como nosso próximo Médico do Trabalho ?

Estamos em busca de um Médico do Trabalho para atuar no suporte à saúde ocupacional de nossas operações no Brasil, contribuindo diretamente para a segurança, o bem-estar e a sustentabilidade de nossas equipes, tanto em ambiente onshore quanto offshore.

Aqui, você fará parte de uma organização global sólida, com forte cultura de HSEQ, processos bem estabelecidos e compromisso genuíno com as pessoas. Buscamos um profissional com visão sistêmica, postura ética e capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com diferentes áreas da companhia.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na gestão da saúde ocupacional, garantindo o cumprimento da legislação vigente;
  • Realizar e supervisionar exames ocupacionais (admissionais, periódicos, retorno ao trabalho, mudança de função e demissionais);
  • Apoiar as rotinas de HSEQ, contribuindo para a prevenção de riscos ocupacionais;
  • Atuar em conformidade com as Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) aplicáveis;
  • Interface com áreas internas, fornecedores e clientes, quando necessário;
  • Apoiar operações offshore, incluindo atendimento a demandas relacionadas à PETROBRAS, quando aplicável.

Formação Acadêmica / Técnica

(Education / Technical Training)

  • Graduação em Medicina;
  • Formação complementar em Medicina do Trabalho;
  • Registro ativo no respectivo Conselho Profissional (CRM);
  • Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho, com registro da especialidade no Conselho Federal de Medicina (RQE);
  • Conhecimento das rotinas de HSEQ;
  • Conhecimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs);
  • Conhecimento das normas ISO 9001, ISO 18001 / ISO 45001 e ISO 14001.

Habilidades Técnicas

(Technical Skills)

  • Demonstrar visão sistêmica;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e de forma colaborativa;
  • Experiência profissional pode compensar a ausência de alguma competência formalmente comprovada.

Experiência

(Experience)

  • Experiência com atividades relacionadas à Medicina do Trabalho;
  • Desejável experiência com suporte à saúde ocupacional em operações offshore;
  • Desejável experiência em atendimento a contratos e demandas da PETROBRAS.

Comentários Adicionais

(Additional Comments)

  • Inglês em nível intermediário ou avançado;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office.

Localização

Essa posição será baseada em Macaé .

Carga horária comercial (Seg - Sex) - regime híbrido (3x2)

OBS: Apenas o primeiro mês será 100% presencial

Quem somos:

A DOF é uma das principais fornecedoras de serviços marítimos e submarinos integrados para o mercado global de energia offshore. Combinamos expertise, ativos e tecnologia para executar operações integradas submersas e offshore de forma segura e confiável - sempre.

Com uma equipe multinacional de aproximadamente 6.000 pessoas e a maior frota mundial de Embarcações de Apoio à Construção (CSVs) e embarcações de alto padrão de Rebocadores de Manuseio de Âncoras (AHTS), apoiamos nossos parceiros com alcance global, escala e capacidade líder no setor. Nossos centros operacionais e unidades de negócios estão na Noruega, Dinamarca, Reino Unido, EUA, Singapura, Brasil, Argentina, Canadá, Angola e Austrália.

Na DOF, você entra em uma organização global confiável, onde segurança, trabalho em equipe e integridade vêm em primeiro lugar. Oferecemos forte crescimento na carreira, desenvolvimento de apoio e uma cultura que valoriza inclusão, reconhecimento e conexão. Construa uma carreira significativa em um ambiente de trabalho que coloque as pessoas em primeiro lugar.

Na DOF, valorizamos a pessoa certa para a função, com base em um alinhamento genuíno com a nossa cultura e propósito. Sabemos, por meio de estudos, que minorias frequentemente não se candidatam caso não atendam a 100% dos requisitos — e queremos mudar isso!

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e positivo é uma prioridade para nós. Por isso, esta vaga também é extensiva a pessoas com deficiência (PCD) . Se este for o seu caso, atualize seu currículo com o número do CID.

A diversidade amplia nosso acesso aos melhores talentos, pois não há limites para quem tem paixão pelo que faz!

  • Ambiente descontraído e motivador;
  • Respeito à Inclusão e Diversidade.

title: Supervisor de Logística
description:
Conheça sua missão:

  • Supervisiona e planeja a demanda diária de acordo com o cronograma de entregas estabelecido. Realiza um controle minucioso por meio do painel de visão detalhada, garantindo a execução de todas as etapas dos pedidos, que incluem separação, conferência, faturamento, transbordo, carregamento, roteirização, baixa adequada e registro correto dos motivos para eventuais falhas nas entregas;
  • Em situações de furo de estoque, acompanha atentamente a gestão do setor, envolvendo a consideração de oferecer produtos similares ou a confirmação da ruptura, visando assegurar que a expedição seja realizada na data de entrega acordada;
  • Garante o fluxo da demanda de retirada imediata do dia, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a produtividade e a qualidade. Também monitora os pedidos com prazos de retirada expirados, tomando as ações necessárias, como o contato com o cliente ou o cancelamento do pedido;
  • Mantém uma interação diária com a torre de controle e também reuniões mensais, avaliando as ocorrências e prestando suporte à equipe de administração logística, com acompanhamento atento do gestor;
  • Exerce supervisão sobre a equipe ADM, garantindo que todas as entregas programadas para o dia tenham Documento de Transporte (DT). Em casos de falta desse documento, atua diretamente junto à transportadora para garantir que o processo de roteirização seja concluído, assegurando que nosso indicador OTIF (On-Time In-Full) não seja prejudicado;
  • Utiliza o painel de roteirização para extrair informações relevantes que embasam suas decisões, antecipando-se a possíveis problemas apontados em ressalvas feitas pelos clientes e agilizando as soluções;
  • Busca constantemente maior agilidade e eficiência na resolução de casos de furo de estoque, aplicando análises cuidadosas e tomando decisões assertivas com relativa autonomia;
  • Identifica os gargalos operacionais e organiza a equipe de acordo com os picos de maior fluxo, assegurando que o tempo de separação dos pedidos e a permanência do cliente no local estejam alinhados com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa;
  • Demonstra habilidade na análise de relatórios, propondo ações destinadas a aprimorar os processos existentes e alcançar os resultados almejados;
  • Contribui com o Gerente de Operações Logísticas, selecionando, contratando, animando, desenvolvendo e retendo conforme avaliação e necessidades do setor;
  • Atua na busca contínua por oportunidades de melhoria, antecipa-se a problemas, contribuindo com soluções adequadas;
  • Colabora com seu gestor na elaboração de relatórios voltados para o aumento da produtividade e o alcance dos objetivos do setor;
  • Torna-se uma referência para a equipe, compartilhando os números do setor e atingindo as metas estabelecidas;
  • Orienta os colaboradores da equipe para o plano diário de gestão, e supervisiona a realização das atividades. Acompanha o controle de estoque, incluindo endereçamentos, armazenamento de posições e realizações de inventários;
  • Assegura o bom uso e manutenção das ferramentas que estão à disposição da suas equipes (Cintas, Etiquetadoras, Coletores de dados, Empilhadeiras, Paleteiras, Rádios, Impressoras, Computadores, etc);
  • Garantir a eficácia de todos os processos relacionados à gestão de inventário, tanto rotativo quanto geral. Monitora a execução dos processos de movimentações, transitórios, endereçamento e negativos e promove a disseminação da cultura de endereçamento correto;
  • Assegura o cumprimento do procedimento de furo de estoque e mantem a vigilância constante sobre o monitoramento de deficiências de estoque no sistema e prepara relatórios semanais sobre o tema. Auxilia no processo de treinamento e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores (loja e logística) para uso dos recursos e aderência aos processos de movimentação e armazenagem de material;
  • Representa papel central na luta anti demarca e apresenta relatórios de maior profundidade durante as reuniões de briefing e, é um modelo de eficácia no contra poder e na adoção de boas práticas;
  • Orientar os colaboradores da equipe para o plano diário de operação, colaborar para a prevenção de perdas, zelar pela qualidade e conservação do estoque de mercadorias, zelar pelo o pátio logístico, direcionando sua equipe para mantê-lo sempre limpo e organizado;
  • Garante que todas as mercadorias sejam conferidas e estejam em perfeitas condições. monitorar a coleta das devoluções conforme acordos comerciais estabelecidos, orientando a equipe para melhor comunicação e seguimento dos processos;
  • Instrui a equipe a comunicar ao suporte de cadastros qualquer discrepância nos produtos cadastrados, como forma de prevenir erros no estoque. Desenvolve escala de trabalho, sempre verificando a necessidade operacional e normas legislativas;
  • Conduz a sua equipe na delimitação adequada dos espaços conforme o produto a ser recebido para otimizar o gerenciamento da conferência e da armazenagem, orienta os terceiros, responsáveis pela paletização, assegurando que esse processo seja realizado corretamente, seguindo os padrões definidos;
  • Garante o registro completo dos fretes FOB e certifica se todos foram pagos corretamente, efetuando o controle do pallets em débito com os fornecedores, garantindo a transparência nas relações comerciais e o cumprimento das obrigações;
  • Cria agendas de treinamentos para os demais setores, sobre o processo de devoluções via acordo comercial, visando instruí-los sobre o procedimento padrão de paletização e conferência, garantindo que todos sigam os protocolos estabelecidos.

Authority

  • The Cargo Supervisor assumes delegated authority for marine activities such as cargo loading and offloading and cargo utilities and maintenance. He or she will work with the Cargo Superintendent and the OIM as required where the safety of the crew and vessel is concerned. Work authority is delegated to competent personnel as appropriate.

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Cargo Operations
    • 1 Prepare to Start Marine and Cargo Operations
    • 2 Startup Marine and Cargo Operations
    • 3 Monitor and Maintain Marine and Cargo Operations
    • 4 Prepare and shutdown Marine and Cargo Operations
    • 5 Contribute to Tank Entry, Inspection and Maintenance Activities
  • 2) Manage And Supervise Effectively
    • 1 Demonstrate leadership in technical and safety issues.
    • 2 Liaise effectively with all relevant onshore and offshore departments.
    • 3 Delegate authority having due regard for competence and verify effective close out of tasks.
    • 4 Promote training and competency assurance throughout the department in line with Company goals for the Unit.
    • 5 Promote safety awareness and application of the Management System regarding immediate safety of personnel (PTW/Risk assessments/inspections).

    • 7 Encourage and support all department personnel to achieve training and competency targets and plan for appropriate time allocation for this area of work.
    • 8 Ensure timely and effective contributions to reporting and investigation of all incidents where required.
  • 3) Contribute To The Control Of Critical Situations And Respond To Emergencies
    • 1 Developing critical situations (operational, weather, equipment failure, leaks, fires personnel etc.) are identified and positive action is taken to limit escalation and to maintain control using applied policies or procedures or initiative
    • 2 Manage emergency response with due regard for safety of personnel, FSO/FPSO and environment
    • 3 Demonstrate knowledge and awareness of potential emergency scenarios.
    • 4 Contribute to the effective de-brief and analysis of exercises.
  • 4) Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures
    • 1 Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits

    • 3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
    • 4 Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
  • 5) Emergency Response
    • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
    • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

  • Realizar as tratativas necessárias para aprovação de multas, bem como análise de histórico, elaboração de relatório e levantamento de evidências para devolução de multas;
  • Apoio na execução das atividades referentes ao encerramento do PCs, bem como no arquivamento de sua documentação;

VAGAS EXCLUSIVAS PARA PCD NO CENTRO CIRURGÍCO - Oferecemos uma oportunidade na Casa de Saúde São José.

DESCRIÇÃO

Nós estamos procurando um profissional dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe de cuidados de saúde.

REQUISITOS

  • Técnicos e enfermeiros.
  • Registro profissional atualizado.
  • Conhecimento em Centro Cirúrgico e CME
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e fornecer atendimento de alta qualidade aos pacientes.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Receber o plantão, realizando conferência dos equipamentos (Check-list).
  • Realizar a organização das respectivas salas.
  • Solicitar o paciente, somente após certificação da autorização de material e presença em sala.
  • Circular a sala cirúrgica de acordo com a escala mensal realizada pela supervisora da unidade.
  • Colaborar no posicionamento do paciente e descobrir a área operada.
  • Auxiliar a instrumentador na contagem de compressas e instrumentais, antes e após a cirurgia e registrar.
  • Posicionar o foco de luz e aproximar baldes e ramperes.
  • Preencher a folha de gastos, anexando invólucros de matérias consignados, descrição cirúrgica, ficha de anestesia, relatório de consignados e registro de material esterilizado.
  • Retirar e conferir o instrumental e encaminhar posteriormente à Central de Material (após o ato cirúrgico).
  • Realizar a devolução, após o término da cirurgia, de todos os materiais consignados que não foram utilizados.
  • Providenciar a limpeza da sala.
  • Zelar por todo material e equipamento dentro da unidade e, se necessário, providenciar conserto.

Nós oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho desafiador e gratificante, onde você terá a oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes. Se você é um profissional de enfermagem apaixonado, dedicado e experiente, nós gostaríamos de ouvir de você.

A Casa de Saúde São José é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para o emprego sem consideração à raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou outras características protegidas pela lei.

INFORMAÇÕES DO EMPREGO

  • Jornada: Período Integral
  • Área e especialização profissional: Saúde - Enfermagem

Escolaridade Mínima: Curso Técnico

FORMAÇÃO DESEJADA

  • Enfermagem, Curso Técnico

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the \'Control Room\' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \'Visualizations\' and that the \'Data Pipelines\' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • 1 0+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Fully Remote position.

Full Time / Part Time: Full-time

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You will be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

We are looking for a Materials Engineer to join our Core Technologies team and provide technical expertise in non-metallic materials and fabrication processes. This role supports global standardization, cost-effective solutions, and innovation across subsea projects.

Job Description

  • Provide non-metallic materials technical support to the Rigid Pipeline, Flexible, Umbilical and SPS Technologies projects
  • Perform engineering to establish and maintain design rules and design tools related to non-metallic materials selection and specifications. Contribute to standardisation initiatives and deploy digital tools for material selection
  • Review materials documentations for projects specific and customer specific requirements.
  • Support projects related to Products Life Maintenance and New Products Developments and contribute to technology roadmaps for non-metallic materials. Participate in the development of planning and budgeting for these projects.
  • Provide Technical support related to non-metallic special processes (extrusion, injection molding, coating, painting) in coordination with TechnipFMC manufacturing units and Supply Chain to ensure flowless high quality projects execution.
  • Collaborate with Core Technologies R&D team and Project & Tender team.
  • Provide technical input during supplier audits, supplier qualification, and technical queries.
  • Maintain state of the art knowledge on coating industry and new materials development in order to identify opportunities for product and process improvements and R&D projects.
  • Liaise with legal, procurement and IP departments to ensure necessary agreement are in place with partners and external entities
  • Location: Tech Center – Ilha do Fundão - RJ

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Degree in Materials Engineering or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • Advanced English
  • Experience in subsea or similar industries.
  • Strong knowledge of non-metallic materials (anti-corrosion and insulation coatings, thermoplastics, elastomers, thermosets) and their manufacturing processes.
  • Familiarity with non-metallics mechanical and ageing tests
  • Experience with SSI principles and digital engineering tools.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

Skills

  • English
  • Corrosion and Aging Test
  • Communication

  • Projetar e implementar modelos de OCR utilizando frameworks e bibliotecas avançadas para extração de dados de documentos estruturados e não estruturados.
  • Analisar, preparar e pré-processar grandes volumes de dados textuais e numéricos para uso em modelos de aprendizado de máquina e deep learning.
  • Desenvolver pipelines de processamento de dados, incluindo extração, transformação e armazenamento dos resultados de OCR.
  • Integrar soluções de OCR com outras ferramentas e sistemas para automatizar fluxos de trabalho e processos de análise de dados.
  • Realizar treinamentos e ajustes finos em modelos de OCR para melhorar a acurácia em cenários específicos, como diferentes idiomas, fontes, formatos e níveis de ruído.
  • Explorar e aplicar técnicas de PNL (Processamento de Linguagem Natural) para enriquecer a análise e categorização dos textos extraídos.
  • Aplicar técnicas de Quimiometria e análise multivariada (como PCA, PLS, regressão multivariada e métodos de classificação) para modelagem, interpretação de dados complexos e apoio à tomada de decisão.
  • Desenvolver modelos preditivos combinando dados textuais, numéricos e espectrais, quando aplicável.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para garantir a integração das soluções de OCR e Quimiometria em projetos maiores de análise de dados.
  • Monitorar e melhorar o desempenho dos modelos em produção, garantindo escalabilidade, robustez e confiabilidade.
  • Pesquisar novas tecnologias relacionadas a OCR, inteligência artificial e Quimiometria, mantendo-se atualizado(a) com as tendências do setor.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística, Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou especialização em Ciência de Dados, IA ou Quimiometria é desejável.
  • Experiência consolidada em projetos de ciência de dados, com foco em OCR, processamento de imagens e/ou análise multivariada.
  • Conhecimento prático em Quimiometria, incluindo técnicas como PCA, PLS, regressão multivariada, métodos de classificação e validação de modelos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em frameworks de deep learning, como TensorFlow, PyTorch ou Keras.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de OCR, como Tesseract, Google Vision, AWS Textract, ABBYY FineReader ou similares.
  • Habilidade com técnicas de pré-processamento de imagens (OpenCV ou PIL) para melhoria da qualidade dos documentos.
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação como Python ou R, com foco em aplicações de ciência de dados e modelagem estatística.
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais para armazenamento e consulta de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de MLOps.

Competências

  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócios complexos em soluções analíticas e técnicas eficientes.
  • Orientar equipes em projetos de alta complexidade e contribuir para o crescimento técnico de colegas.
  • Compromisso com a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade e impacto mensurável.
  • Habilidade de apresentar insights técnicos a públicos técnicos e não técnicos de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Proatividade para propor soluções inovadoras e superar desafios técnicos.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência aplicada em Quimiometria para dados reais, incluindo interpretação de modelos e comunicação de resultados para áreas de negócio.
  • Familiaridade com modelos pré-treinados como Google Vision AI, AWS Textract ou Azure Cognitive Services.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas avançadas de PNL para análise e organização de textos extraídos.
  • Experiência com implantação de soluções de OCR e modelos quimiométricos em ambientes de produção e escaláveis, incluindo nuvem (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud).
  • Certificações relevantes, como Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate ou Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer.

title: Social Investment Senior Advisor
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Job Family Group: Corporate Relations

Worker Type: Regular

Posting Start Date: December 9, 2025

Business Unit: CoS and Corporate Relations

Experience Level: Experienced Professionals

What’s the role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to create a positive presence and legacy in the communities and countries in which we operate and to be a trusted and responsible neighbour. We do this by engaging with our communities, identifying and mitigating the social impacts of our operations, and delivering benefits through social investment. You will be working closely with the Societal Impact and Energy Transition Program Manager and business colleagues in the country, as well as the regional and global Social Performance Centre of Excellence in Shell.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing and implementing a robust social investment strategy for Shell in Brazil that is aligned with our business objectives in-country, Shell’s Group social investment strategy and requirements, and the social context of our communities
  • Identifying and designing meaningful social investment programmes in line with the strategy
  • Selecting and managing delivery partners to help us implement our social investment programmes
  • Driving implementation of the social investment programmes, with clear oversight and regular review of performance against goals and targets
  • Developing and executing monitoring, evaluation, and learning plans for our social investment programmes, jointly with our delivery partners
  • Undertaking social baseline and evaluation studies as needed to help inform and continuously improve social investment programmes
  • Developing and implementing impact-led communication plans for internal and external stakeholders
  • Engaging leaders to create a shared vision and internal alignment on Shell Brazil social investment objectives and activities
  • Representing Shell externally and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders including communities, government, joint venture partners, civil society organisations, among others
  • Proactively identifying and managing risks to the social investment programmes, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to ensure the programmes remain externally relevant, impactful, and efficient
  • Developing and coordinating the disaster response plans for supporting communities where needed
  • Ensuring compliance with Shell’s business principles, ethics, and compliance standards
  • Ensuring budget and activity planning and tracking progress, and compliance with Shell’s global reporting requirements for social investment spend and outcomes

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 15+ years of experience with qualifications relevant to social development
  • Significant experience and proven track record in designing and delivering social development programmes, in particular related to STEM skills, enterprise development, and livelihood programmes
  • Experience working with corporates in designing and delivering social programmes with a good understanding of business processes and influencing senior business leaders
  • Extensive external network in the development sector to help create strong collaborations and partnerships
  • Experience managing external delivery partners
  • Experience in developing monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks; measuring and reporting impacts
  • Strategic and critical thinking skills to design and develop new programmes, and the ability to troubleshoot and solve problems
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), presentation, and facilitation skills; business fluency in English is a minimum requirement
  • Excellent collaboration, stakeholder influencing, and management skills across organizational boundaries and different levels of seniority, without direct authority
  • Ability to uphold high‑quality standards, anticipate and manage risks
  • Excellent project/programme management skills
  • Solid team leadership skills
  • Learner Mindset – role model curiosity and reflection, and encourage people to learn from mistakes and successes
  • Maximise performance – integrate and collaborate across boundaries to maximise commercial value for the organisation as a whole

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator
description:
Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. In addition, they will oversee infrastructure and overlay delivery, installation, and dismantling, as well as supply and storage of field of play and training equipment at training sites.

As a member of the Technical Services & Overlay team, you will also work closely with other workstreams, such as Pitch Management, Venue Design, and Dressing and Signage, to ensure the FWWC2027 is delivered to the highest possible standard and, where possible, leaves a lasting legacy.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA's exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist the Training Site Infrastructure Manage in the design and delivery of infrastructure required at training sites for the FWWC2027.
  • Ensure specifications, space and area allocations are developed in compliance with the FIFA training site requirements and fit for purpose.
  • Monitoring the training site renovations, beautifications and upgrade program and overlay deliverables and timelines to ensure all training sites are ready for the participating Teams when they arrive.
  • Assist in the procurement, delivery and installation/storage of field of play and training equipment for all training sites.
  • Participating in regular review meetings to discuss the delivery and readiness of training sites with all external and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the handover and hand back of all training sites for the tournament period.
  • Working with Facility Management Services and Cleaning & Waste providers to ensure the training sites are maintained at the appropriate standards during the Teams’ time in the host country.
  • Ensure all equipment and overlay requested are provided and set up by the requirements and location.

Your Profile

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a coordination role in overlay, infrastructure, or technical services in events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Strong and dynamic interpersonal, leadership and communication skills with an ability to maintain focus in a high-pressure and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in supplier coordination.
  • Relationships with local suppliers and contractors and well-established networks within the industry would be advantageous.
  • Reliable and committed to meeting quality standards and deadlines, good planning and anticipation, focus on efficient implementation, and follow up after completion.
  • Knowledge of overlay delivery, temporary infrastructure, and technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license is a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Technician, RF Operations

As a NOC Technician, you will work in a 24/7 environment providing technical expertise for Radio Frequency (RF) issues, service performance issues, Occasional Use (OU), full‑time managed services and special events. In this position you will offer troubleshooting support and analysis for resolution of service issues. You will be responsible for monitoring, validating and reporting issues affecting our databases and tools. In this role, you will support the integration of new technologies, follow operational procedures, utilize training material and contribute towards departmental projects. You will consistently collaborate to support team/peer leaders and focus on professional development. The role is focused on supporting the SES customer base. This role also requires a candidate with written and verbal fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support customer calls and requests in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
  • Contribute toward and demonstrate a high level of teamwork.
  • Participate in tool development input to improve customer service delivery.
  • Assist peer team leaders with service documentation and departmental documentation.
  • Provide operational support with a timely and professional response to customer calls, emails and any SES‑approved communications application.
  • Participate in routine operational activities, on‑boarding of new systems, and alarm monitoring to mitigate customer impact.
  • Assist with tracking and executing maintenance activities.
  • Utilize tools and demonstrate general proficiency to troubleshoot RF service issues.
  • Act as the primary contact for service issue resolution support of RF service issues and a point of escalation for other operations teams.
  • Assist in identifying, updating, and escalating service issues to determine alternate routing, emergency restoral, and timely resolution of service discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with SES support groups and/or customer engineers to activate new services.
  • Create and review tickets for RF interference or service issues to ensure accurate documentation and completion of follow‑up actions.
  • Escalate and report service issues, corrective measures, and next steps to the management team.

COMPETENCIES

  • Demonstrating core company behavioral competencies, including adaptability, critical thinking, openness, and a positive attitude.
  • Serving as a culture champion with experience fostering inclusive work environments and embracing diverse thinking and styles.
  • Contributing to a customer‑oriented culture and promoting a quality work environment.
  • Displaying great verbal and written communication skills.
  • Assisting in the development of tools, training programs, processes, and procedures.
  • Performing other duties as assigned by peer leaders and management.
  • Collaborating with peers and other SES teams to provide a great customer experience.
  • Familiarization with SES offered products and services.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Associate’s degree or technical school diploma or at least two years of relevant experience in a teleport, network operations, or broadcast environment (or an equivalent combination of education and experience).
  • Working knowledge of satellite, fiber, data, and/or broadcast related equipment.
  • General knowledge of video broadcast technology and digital compression desired.
  • Must be able to work 24x7 rotating shifts.
  • Must be able to make decisions and collaborate in a high‑pressure, fast‑paced environment.
  • Must be able to convey complex technical issues to individuals of varying skill levels.
  • Must consistently display good teamwork, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work comfortably with customers and co‑workers who speak English as a second language.
  • Must consistently display situational awareness and take initiative to address both customer issues as well as departmental inefficiencies with some supervision.
  • Must have effective computer skills and the ability to read and understand operational manuals.

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • Job requires ability to sit for long periods of time.
  • Employee must be able and willing to work in a 24‑hour shift environment, with work on nights, weekends and holidays.

About The Role

We're looking for a product designer to join the Merchant Success team for Grocery & Retail at Uber Eats. As part of this team, you'll play a key role in building trust with merchants through new capabilities like reporting and insights, disbursements, invoicing, and more to help them run their business successfully.

At Uber, Product Designers tackle challenges and work on big new ideas that will transform how people use our products. In a rapidly growing environment, you'll collaborate with engineers, product managers, content designers and some of the world's best designers and researchers. Uber Design makes magic by crafting and shipping delightful experiences for people around the globe.

What The Candidate Will Do

  • Onboard to the Uber Design team: Learn how we collaborate and use design tools, how to design with the Uber Base design system, and how we design for clarity, inclusion, accessibility, scalability, and global localization.
  • Onboard to your product area: Meet your cross-functional stakeholders, learn about their business goals and strategy, get familiar with existing tech platforms, and understand your team's product development and launch review process.
  • Scope: Work on projects of all sizes, from problems that are well-known to those more complex and conceptual, while leading a roadmap in your product area.
  • Process: Build a deep understanding of the users you are designing for through data and research, lead the end-to-end design process, solicit and incorporate feedback from experts, translate your designs to build with engineers, and work flexibly with a variety of teams. Design at all levels of fidelity, thoroughly explore the problem space, and practice good judgment on making tradeoffs.
  • Craft: Turn big ideas into simple, elegant products. Ship features that are effective and easy to use. Deliver designs that are innovative and scalable. Document design frameworks so others can build upon your solutions. Have a strong understanding of business, data, and engineering requirements, and create experiences that deliver real customer value.
  • Efficiency: Prioritize and manage your time efficiently, operate with high autonomy, manage several concurrent projects at once, and collaborate effectively.
  • Communication: Communicate with clarity and persuasiveness, and effectively present your work and rationale to all the relevant stakeholders. Proactively communicate with your team and manager, facilitate design sessions, and collaborate with other designers. Maintain honest and trusting relationships with your team.
  • Influence: Lead team activities through ideas, organization, and execution. Supports internal initiatives to improve the Design team. Share your skills and learnings with other team members.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of Product Design experience
  • Experience building products for mobile apps, tablets, and web interfaces
  • A portfolio showing your high-quality, thoughtful UI and UX work
  • Fluent/Advanced English skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with Figma or similar tools and prototyping methods
  • Experience working with user experience researchers and various methods of research
  • Experience working and collaborating in a tech environment
  • Shipped many successful software products, ideally both mobile and desktop
  • Highly proficient in storytelling and prototyping
  • Ability to strongly articulate your design work and rationale to your peers and cross-functional team
  • Experience designing with large-scale design systems and frameworks

O Monster Ambassador Team é um programa de marketing global da Monster Energy Company. O objetivo do programa é:

  5. Ter um alto nível de energia com uma atitude de “consigo fazer”.
  6. Preocupar-se com a imagem pessoal e higiene.
  7. Ser socialmente responsável, extrovertido e prezar pela diversidade.
  8. Ter interesse em esportes de ação é um extra.
  9. Experiência promocional é um extra.
  10. Domínio fluente de inglês, espanhol ou outros idiomas é um extra.

We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  • Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  • Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  • Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  • DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um profissional para garantir o cumprimento das metas através da comercialização de produtos e serviços TOTVS com um processo que permita buscar um suspect, compreender suas necessidades, apresentar produtos e serviços, gerar oportunidades, propor, adequar, vender e entregar soluções, sempre mantendo um contínuo relacionamento técnico e empresarial.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir sua carteira de clientes e construir um relacionamento visando rentabilizar, blindar e elevar o nível de satisfação da base TOTVS em relação às responsabilidades do AR nos indicadores de NPS (Farmer);
  • Prospectar novos negócios na base instalada e/ou em novos clientes, visando ampliar Market Share TOTVS (Hunter);
  • Planejar e executar o plano tático alinhado ao planejamento estratégico da DRG e resultados de vendas no segmento/região de atuação;
  • Ser especialista e liderar o assunto no seu negócio, sendo capaz de estabelecer discursos e formas de atuação altamente adequadas ao perfil de cada cliente/prospect/segmento;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas individuais e metas de venda do time do Comercial em que estiver atuando, de acordo com a estratégia da TOTVS;
  • Visitar e assistir a base instalada e os novos clientes, garantindo sempre a excelência do atendimento TOTVS e buscando recorrentemente novos negócios;
  • Atender e se relacionar com o mercado e com a base instalada, através de visitas, reuniões, contatos telefônicos e e-mails;
  • Planejar, executar e liderar o processo de vendas de um produto ou serviço TOTVS ao mercado;

  • Mentorar profissionais do AR com o objetivo de compartilhar conhecimento e colaborar para o desenvolvimento da equipe;
  • Ser referência técnica e comercial no seu segmento de atuação;
  • Exercer liderança informal na equipe, apoiando diretamente a gestão formal da empresa;
  • Atuar como multiplicador de conhecimento e auxiliar no desenvolvimento de executivos com alto nível de performance, atuando como buddy para novos TOTVERs;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva em abordagens comerciais por meio de soluções segmentadas conforme área de atuação, potencializando a percepção de valor pelo cliente/prospect sobre os produtos e serviços TOTVS.

  • Pós Graduação, Especialização ou MBA completo;
  • Vivência com vendas B2B de software de tecnologia e ERP;
  • Perfil Hunter, de prospecção de novos negócios;
  • Familiaridade com segmento de Supply Chain.
  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada TOTVER;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para TOTVERS;

  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

Como empresa líder em tecnologia somos um universo de pessoas inconformadas, movidas por inovação, autonomia, aprendizado e performance. Juntos e juntas, criamos oportunidades, transformamos futuros e compartilhamos conhecimento. Aqui o seu desenvolvimento profissional acontece em um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e energizante. De gente pra gente! Buscamos o crescimento sustentável. E usamos dados e IA para impulsionar resultados mais inteligentes e eficientes para os nossos clientes. title: Tech Talent Program 2026
description:
Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for curious, analytical, and forward-thinking problem-solvers to join our Subsurface Imaging team at Viridien as part of our Tech Talent Program 2026 in a full-time position.

In this role, you will apply your knowledge of physics, mathematics, and technology to solve challenges across energy, infrastructure, and Earth data solutions. Working alongside industry experts, you will contribute to cutting-edge projects that redefine how we explore and understand the Earth’s subsurface.

To support your success, we provide structured onboarding, comprehensive technical training, and ongoing mentorship. You will learn how to transform raw seismic data into high-resolution 3D subsurface models, generating insights that support sustainable exploration and environmental stewardship.

Responsibilities

  • Apply advanced physics, mathematics, and geoscience principles to process and interpret seismic data.
  • Use state-of-the-art imaging techniques and high-performance computing (HPC) to tackle complex geophysical challenges.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and improve algorithms, tools, and workflows.
  • Work closely with Research and Software Development teams to help shape next-generation technologies.
  • Contribute to scientific publications, present findings, and support innovation across the organization and the wider geophysical community.

About the Team

You will join a supportive and collaborative team working on real-world geophysical challenges.

Our culture is driven by science, sparked by collaboration, and propelled by ambition — pillars that reflect what makes working at Viridien unique and exciting. They shape how we learn from each other, tackle complex problems, and grow together in an environment that encourages curiosity, teamwork, and continuous development from day one.

Qualifications

  • A PhD or Master’s degree in Geophysics, Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills.
  • A collaborative mindset, curiosity, and a genuine interest in innovation and continuous learning.

Benefits

At Viridien, we support both your professional growth and personal well-being:

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private pension plan.
  • Meal voucher.
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu therapy available on site.
  • TotalPass fitness program.
  • Hybrid work model (up to 2 remote days per week).
  • Birthday day off.
  • Christmas gift card.
  • Educational assistance and language learning programs.
  • Continuous development through our Learning Hub, offering both technical and behavioral training.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.

We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.

We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

title: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande , Espírito Empreendedor , Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre nós

O nosso propósito é transformar o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Começamos em 2001, como um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre. Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de pessoas talentosas que, por meio da nossa cultura de Sonho Grande, Mente Aberta e Espírito Empreendedor, tiveram a autonomia e liberdade que precisavam para transformar o mercado financeiro.

Porém, sabemos que o desafio é muito maior. Os grandes bancos ainda possuem 95% do mercado de investimentos no Brasil, mas estamos aqui para romper essa lógica e melhorar a vida de muito mais pessoas. Somos exatamente o que o sistema financeiro nunca foi.

Se você se identifica com esses conceitos e deseja construir algo especial, mergulhe de cabeça nesta oportunidade.

Como Sales Trader, você irá atuar auxiliando nossos clientes mais relevantes nas tomadas de decisão no universo da renda variável, levando em consideração o momento de mercado, a visão do nosso time de research e o perfil de cada investidor. Buscamos pessoas extremamente organizadas, além habilidades técnicas e comerciais a fim de desenvolver um trabalho de excelência junto a nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

  • Transmitir recomendações de operações de curto, médio e longo prazo, de acordo com o perfil do cliente;

A Concessionária A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Descrição da vaga Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world‑class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We’re looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

This is a Lisbon‑based position, and relocation will be required. Relocation support may be provided for the selected candidate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards.
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators.
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements.
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity.
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team.

Must Have

  • Perform end‑to‑end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming).
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs.
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems.
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21).
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services).
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc.) during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch.
  • Follow‑up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service.
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers.
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills.
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.
